checks: ECDSA P-256 signature on exact externally pinned anchor digest and predecessor
Compare local journal history at externally pinned sequence and SHA-256 head
Compare a full local registry snapshot digest and revocation epoch
Reject jointly rolled-back journal and registry when remote anchor records later sequence
Holder, issuer and source control-root separation, replayed anchor ID and nonce
Local file inspection refuses missing registry, pending update, torn/corrupt ledger
limitations: No real remote custodian or independent receipt was supplied
Holder authenticity booleans are caller assertions; independent external verification is not established
This is an observation gate with may_append=false and may_recover=false, not an automatic recovery procedure
Joint rollback can evade local-only checks if the purported remote anchor is also controlled or rewound
No distributed consensus, cross-host fencing or physical-act authority
Cargo tests, GitHub Actions results and live Pages deployment not independently confirmed
